description: SYNTHORA defi-yields: stablecoin DeFi yields ranked with a risk outlier detector — APY vs class median (>=3x median = the excess yield IS the risk price). Only pools with TVL >= $10M. Source: DefiLlama, free, no key. $0.01 USDC x402 Base. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]

activo.description: Optional nonempty asset symbol token. It is trimmed, uppercased and matched against tokens of the pool symbol (for example USDC); not a substring, contract-address or mint lookup. Omit for all eligible symbols. A token with no matches may produce an empty selected list.

desde.description: Optional timezone-aware ISO8601 cut, not in the future. Compares current eligible pools with the latest local batch at or before that cut. Changes use the full eligible universe, independently of red/activo/protocolo display filters. Missing older batches are reported; no history coverage is guaranteed.

historial_dias.description: Requires pool_id; history availability is not guaranteed.

pool_id.description: Optional exact pool ID for local batch-history retrieval only; it does not filter the current top-pool list. History defaults to 30 days unless historial_dias supplies 1-90. This is not a live DefiLlama history request; missing local history is disclosed as a gap.

protocolo.description: Optional nonempty protocol/project identifier, such as aave-v3. Trimmed and matched case-insensitively for exact equality with pool.proyecto; not a substring or protocol-contract lookup. Omit for all projects in the captured eligible universe.

red.description: Optional nonempty chain name, trimmed and matched case-insensitively for exact equality against captured pool.chain. Omit for all captured eligible chains. A chain outside that captured universe returns an explicit error; this does not select another data source.

name: defi_yields
